comments.content: - **server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:15** — Making `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp` required leaves all eight `getMetadataForIds.mockResolvedValue(...)` fixtures in `album.service.spec.ts` missing a mandatory field. Running `npm run check` produces TypeScript errors, so the repository’s standard typecheck fails.

- **server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:167** — Casting `updatedAt` to `date` discards its time. If an asset is updated at 09:00 and again at 17:00 UTC on the same day, both responses contain midnight; mobile’s `_hasRemoteAlbumChanged` comparison sees no change and skips synchronizing the album.

- **server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:146 and 156** — Casting `localDateTime` to `date` changes the returned start/end instants. For an asset dated `2025-01-01T13:00:00Z`, a browser in New York previously displayed January 1; the new midnight timestamp localizes to December 31, so album date ranges become incorrect.## 1. `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp` is no longer a timestamp — breaks the mobile app's album change-detection (perpetual re-sync)

**File/line:** `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:161-171` (hunk `@@ -132,18 +133,53 @@`; the cast is at lines 165-168): `max(("assets"."updatedAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)`.

`updatedAt` is a `timestamptz` (`server/src/entities/asset.entity.ts:96-97`); the `::date` cast truncates it to midnight UTC. The field is documented (even in this diff's own comment) as the mobile-app-only signal, and the mobile uses it as an exact-instant equality check:

- `mobile/lib/services/sync.service.dart:997-1009` (`_hasRemoteAlbumChanged`) — skips the whole album details/asset re-sync when `isAtSameMomentAs(remoteAlbum.lastModifiedAssetTimestamp, dbAlbum.lastModifiedAssetTimestamp)` is true.
- `mobile/lib/repositories/album.repository.dart:119-120` (`recalculateMetadata`) — after any sync the app overwrites the stored value with the **exact** `max(updatedAt)` of its local assets.

Failure scenario: server now returns `2026-08-27T00:00:00.000Z` while the locally recalculated value is the real instant (`2026-08-27T14:37:22.000Z`). These are equal only if an asset was updated at exactly UTC midnight, so `_hasRemoteAlbumChanged` returns true for **every album with assets on every sync run** — the mobile re-fetches full album details, diffs and upserts all assets, and rewrites album rows each time, for every album. Before this change both sides were exact instants and matched. A second consequence of the same truncation: two albums whose newest asset updates landed at 08:00Z and 23:30Z on the same day now both read `00:00:00Z`, so any recency ordering or "last modified" display built on this field (its stated purpose) ties them and is off by up to 24 hours.

## 2. `startDate`/`endDate` truncated to the UTC calendar date — off-by-one-day album date labels for non-UTC users

**File/line:** `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:141-160` (hunk `@@ -132,18 +133,53 @@`; casts at lines 144-147 and 153-157): `min/max(("assets"."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)`.

`localDateTime` is a `timestamptz` holding the true capture instant. The web client renders these fields in the **user's local timezone** (`web/src/lib/components/album-page/albums-table-row.svelte:61-69`, `album-card.svelte:69-71`, `albums-list.svelte:88`), so truncating to the UTC date before serialization shifts the displayed calendar day whenever the capture's local date ≠ its UTC date.

Failure scenario: user in UTC+9 adds a photo taken 2026-01-02 06:00 local (= 2026-01-01T21:00Z). Before the change, `endDate` = `2026-01-01T21:00:00.000Z` and the web renders "Jan 2". After the change, `endDate` = `2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`, which localizes to Jan 1 15:00 — the album card/table now shows "Jan 1", a day before the actual capture; a single-photo album even shows its date range starting and ending on the wrong day. Any capture between local midnight and the local offset (e.g. morning shots for UTC+x zones) is shifted back one day; before the change the raw instant was returned and local rendering was correct.

## 3. Generated SQL snapshot not regenerated — deterministic CI failure

**File/line:** the rewritten query at `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts:136-182` (hunk `@@ -132,18 +133,53 @@`) has no corresponding update to the committed snapshot `server/src/queries/album.repository.sql:202-216`, which still contains the old query (`select "albums"."id" ..., min("assets"."localDateTime") ...`) and no `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp`.

CI enforces these snapshots: `.github/workflows/test.yml:544-559` runs `npm run sync:sql` (regenerates `server/src/queries/*.sql` against a real DB) and then hard-fails with "ERROR: Generated SQL files not up to date!" if the files changed. Since the PR head's committed snapshot still has the old query shape while `getMetadataForIds` now produces different SQL (new join direction, `AT TIME ZONE`/`::date` expressions, extra `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp` column, new aliases/grouping), the regeneration step produces a diff and the workflow exits 1 — the PR cannot pass CI as-is.

**DEFECT 1: `startDate` and `endDate` lose time precision — truncates to midnight UTC**

- **File:** `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts` (lines 141–159)
- **Failure scenario:** Album has assets with `localDateTime` of `2020-12-31T23:59:00.000Z` (earliest) and `2025-01-01T01:02:03.456Z` (latest).  
  **Old behaviour:** `startDate = 2020-12-31T23:59:00.000Z`, `endDate = 2025-01-01T01:02:03.456Z` (full timestamps).  
  **New behaviour:** `startDate = 2020-12-31T00:00:00.000Z`, `endDate = 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z` (date-only, time zeroed).  
  The `::date` cast in the SQL (`("assets"."localDateTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date`) discards the time component. The DTO (`AlbumResponseDto`) and `mapAlbum` both expect full `Date` timestamps (see test at `server/src/dtos/album-response.dto.spec.ts:7–8` asserting `2020-12-31T23:59:00.000Z`).

---

**DEFECT 2: `lastModifiedAssetTimestamp` loses time precision — same root cause**

- **File:** `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts` (lines 162–170)
- **Failure scenario:** Album's most-recently-updated asset has `updatedAt = 2024-06-15T14:30:45.123Z`.  
  **Old behaviour (via removed `getLastUpdatedAssetForAlbumId`):** returned full timestamp `2024-06-15T14:30:45.123Z`.  
  **New behaviour:** returns `2024-06-15T00:00:00.000Z` (date-only).  
  The `::date` cast on `assets.updatedAt` discards time. The service at `album.service.ts:68,84` passes this value directly to the DTO.

---

**DEFECT 3: Timezone conversion is suspect for `timestamptz` columns**

- **File:** `server/src/repositories/album.repository.ts` (lines 144–146, 154–156, 165–167)
- Both `localDateTime` and `updatedAt` are `TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE` (see migration `1694525143117-AddLocalDateTime.ts:7` and `1675667878312-AddUpdatedAtColumnToAlbumsUsersAssets.ts:9`).  
  `timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` converts to UTC and returns `timestamp WITHOUT time zone`. The subsequent `::date` then takes the date of that UTC timestamp — which is correct for *date-only* grouping, but **wrong when the consumer expects the original timestamp**. The old query used `eb.fn.min('assets.localDateTime')` directly, preserving the full `timestamptz` value.

---

**DEFECT 4: Tests will fail / mask the regression**

- **File:** `server/src/services/album.service.spec.ts` (e.g., lines 60–61, 102–103, 448–449, etc.)
- Mocks return `startDate: new Date('1970-01-01')` (midnight UTC). The new query *also* returns midnight UTC, so unit tests pass despite the production behaviour being broken for real timestamps. The integration test at `album-response.dto.spec.ts:7–8` uses real `mapAlbum` with fixture data containing non-midnight times and will fail once the repository change is exercised.

---

No other defects found (join restructuring is logically equivalent for inner joins; albums without assets correctly return no metadata row in both old and new queries).
